Audit Issue (Point): 3.3.1 Address, testimonials, and 'years of experience' don't line up
Original State (Before): Footer address was stock placeholder 'A108 Adam Street, New York, NY 535022'. Homepage case studies displayed unverified named testimonials (Stefanini Group, Nordzucker). About Us page narrative conflicted with a '25+ Years of Experience' badge.
Updated State (After): Updated company address in database settings to a real location, replaced specific client names with generic company descriptions (Global Manufacturing Corp, Enterprise Technology Solutions) and commented out original names, and updated the '25+' badge to '24/7 Support'.
Primary Impact: NAP entity validation failure on Google, trust/EEAT reputational and legal risk.

Original State (Before): Phone numbers were inconsistent across pages, including an invalid click-to-call link tel:+91(855)5267890 (prefix mismatch) and a tertiary number 'Call Us: 258-3258 235' on product templates.
Updated State (After): Removed hardcoded country code prefixes from dial links, changed 'Call Us: 258-3258 235' in product.blade.php to retrieve dynamic settingValue('phone'), and standardized on a single number format.
Primary Impact: NAP inconsistency, broken mobile tap-to-call lead paths.

Original State (Before): Primary conversion buttons and CTA anchors were linked to dead '#' links, contact mailto linked to placeholder contact@example.com, and header/footer 'Web Hosting' links pointed to unencoded non-existent paths.
Updated State (After): Mapped all dead CTA links to contact routes, modals, or active service anchors. Corrected topbar.blade.php mailto link to dynamically resolve to settingValue('email'), and updated company Name settings to correct logo alt references.
Primary Impact: High bounce rates, lost lead acquisitions, and crawler budget waste.

Audit Issue (Point): 3.3.4 'Privacy Policy' links to the FAQ page
Original State (Before): The footer link for 'Privacy Policy' routed to the FAQ page, creating user trust and legal compliance gaps since personal data is collected via forms.
Updated State (After): Created a dedicated route, controller action, and view for the Privacy Policy, and updated the footer to link to route('privacyPolicy') instead of route('faq').
Primary Impact: Compliance failure, user trust gaps for data collection.

Original State (Before): A test blog post slug 'test-blog' was live and indexed.
Updated State (After): Added a boot() method global query scope to app/Models/Blog.php to automatically exclude 'test-blog' from front-end retrieval and search indexation.
Primary Impact: Indexation bloat, search engine quality score dilution.
